title: Flower of Friendship
body: The Flower of Friendship is a part of the My Island Collab. The Flower of Friendship can be sold for studs for the event. This tree can be found all around Finlay. It has pink flowers stemming out of the top and trees branches. This tree has no monetary value besides being sold for Studs which are the respective event currency used at the Events Hub, the Stud Headquarters.
